newsitem.title: UK: BT appoints GTS as distributor in Hungary.
newsitem.headline: BT appoints GTS as distributor in Hungary.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc (BT) said it had appointed GTS Hungary, a subsidiary of Global TeleSystems Group Inc, as its distributor of Concert services in Hungary.
It said it had also launched Concert Frame Relay Services.
Concert is BT's joint venture with MCI which provides managed networks.
BT said in a statement that GTS Hungary would offer both sales and support for companies requiring international data connectivity.
Global TeleSystems Group is based in Washington and is an independent developer and operator of telecommunications companies with over 10 years experience in eastern and central Europe, BT said.
GTS already distributes BT services in the Czech Republic.
